newsitem.title: USA: PMI Group default rate rose.
newsitem.headline: PMI Group default rate rose.

text.p: PMI Group Inc, which earlier reported higher third quarter earnings, said its percentage of insured loans in default was 2.03 percent as of September 30, up from 1.88 percent the year before, and 1.96 percent at June 30, 1996.
"As expected, with the maturation of PMI's large 1992 and 1993 books of business, our default rate increased slightly over the second quarter's results," the company said in a statement.

"However, offsetting this increase in the default rate is the continued improvement we're seeing in our California book of business. Our California default inventory and default rate have both shown steady improvement since the first quarter of this year."
